forex_range_reentry.family: Mean reversion after closed-bar Bollinger re-entry
forex_range_reentry.entry: Previous close outside band; current close back inside, directional body, close in favorable 35%, RSI on matching half
forex_range_reentry.stop: Last three closed candles plus shared ATR floor/buffer
forex_range_reentry.target: Current Bollinger mean minus shared target buffer; mandatory cap
forex_range_reentry.score: 80 mandatory, +10 prior RSI extreme, +10 close strength

forex_squeeze_breakout.entry: Prior bandwidth at/below past quantile; current close beyond previous 10-bar extreme; directional body and favorable 30% close
forex_squeeze_breakout.stop: Last three closed candles plus shared ATR floor/buffer
forex_squeeze_breakout.target: Shared ATR/2R, capped by confirmed opposing pivot
forex_squeeze_breakout.score: 80 mandatory, +10 above-mean tick activity, +10 close in favorable 15%

shared_guards: Score >=78; net RR >=1.5; max stop4ATR; max2 confirmed positions; original global budget/cooldown/daily/streak/account/spec checks; no martingale; fixed exits; known friction priced before lot sizing
screening_pass: Every development date/cost case: realized PnL>0 AND equity change>0 AND at least one closed trade; at least20 closed trades across development at EACH cost profile
selection_rule: Among screening passes only: highest worst-case equity change; then highest mean equity change; then lowest worst drawdown; then strategy id
confirmation_rule: Evaluate only one frozen selected candidate, once, on 19/10 at both cost profiles; do not open confirmation if none passes screening. Positive each case, >=10 closed each profile; otherwise reject/insufficient. Do not retune after confirmation.
operational_promotion: No automatic operational change. A screening/confirmation pass on this short dataset is not proof; require further independent data and meaningful forward demo evidence.
limitations: OHLC and spread approximation; current monetary specifications frozen.
Two-day development and one reserved day are a screening procedure, not adequate financial validation.
Previously used dates are not an independent holdout.
Failed/insufficient cases must remain in report.
